$comment: The front-desk character, in one place. The brain (backend/persona.py) and the page (frontend/src/persona.ts) both read this file: change the character, a voice or a language here and nowhere else. `character` is the @voqalize/avatar face; `voices` maps each offered language to a Voqalize voice id that speaks it; `names` is how she says her own name in each language.
